noticeModalOpaqueFix: THÔNG BÁO QUẢN TRỊ · modal/overlay opacity bugfix (LOCAL ONLY, CSS-only, NO business/schema/API change, NO overlay-opacity hack). ROOT CAUSE: .phf-notice-ov is document.body.appendChild(ov) — OUTSIDE .phf-notice — so after the UI/UX pass switched .phf-notice-ov-panel/head/steps/foot from background:#fff to background:var(--nt-cream), those vars resolved to nothing at body scope and the panels rendered TRANSPARENT (page content bled through Đăng thông báo / Chỉnh sửa / Báo cáo tiếp nhận / Lịch sử / Thêm danh mục). FIX (shared, root cause): .phf-notice-ov now re-declares the full --nt-* token set + font-family + box-sizing for its whole subtree; every modal surface (panel/head/body/steps/foot) gets an opaque cream background WITH a literal fallback var(--nt-cream,#FBFAF6); .phf-notice-ov-body gained an explicit cream bg + min-height:0 so the flex body is the ONLY scroller and the sticky footer/header can never be pushed out (or clipped by the panel overflow:hidden). Sub-surfaces stay white: summary / preview / rich editor / report KPI / scroll / tablewrap = background:#fff inside .phf-notice-ov-body. Report/Audit overlay = single scroll region (nested .phf-notice-scroll max-height removed; its sticky th anchors to the body scroll). Scrim opacity UNCHANGED (rgba(20,26,34,.44)). Zoom 25%: overlay align-items:flex-start + panel max-height:94vh at the <=640 breakpoint. Cache-bust phf-notice.css/js -> 1.68.9_notice_modal_opaque_fix. Tests: offline 90/90 (updated 78/81, +89/90), live e2e 130/130, sanitizer 0 XSS leaks. No Home/Task/Competition/Checklist/KNL/QTTH change.
